name: Detroit Institute of Bagels
summary: Permanently closed. Detroit Institute of Bagels operated in Corktown from 2013 until a pandemic-era closure in 2020, reopened at 4884 Grand River Avenue in Core City in February 2023, and closed abruptly in July 2024 immediately after the business was sold to developer Philip Kafka of Prince Concepts, who terminated the remaining staff. No reopening followed. The Grand River Avenue space was taken over by Bev's Bagels, a separate business from chef Max Sussman, announced in April 2025. DIB's own website still advertises the 2023 reopening and daily hours; that copy predates the sale and is not current.
hoursNote: Permanently closed. Any hours still published on the bakery's own website predate the July 2024 closure.

sources.label: Crain's Detroit Business, "Detroit Institute of Bagels abruptly closes following sale to developer"
sources.note: Published 2024-07-24. Business closed immediately after the sale to Philip Kafka was completed.

sources.label: BridgeDetroit, "Detroit Institute of Bagels sold to developer who closes shop"
sources.note: Published 2024-07-24. Kafka emailed remaining staff terminating them; doors closed indefinitely. Independent confirmation of the Crain's report.

sources.label: Eater Detroit, Bev's Bagels to open in the former DIB space
sources.note: Published 2025-04-10. Confirms 4884 Grand River Ave is now Bev's Bagels, a separate business, so the DIB location is not dormant but reoccupied.

sources.label: Official website homepage (stale)
